questions.question: What is the modern era also called?

Incorrect. The classical period refers to classical antiquity, which came before the modern era.
Incorrect. The medieval period refers to the Middle Ages, which came before the modern era.
Incorrect. The ancient period refers to ancient times, which came before the Middle Ages and the modern era.
